Name: Farmer Birthday
Author: DeyvidMods
Description:
🎂 FARMER BIRTHDAY

Your farmer celebrates everyone else's birthday... now it's finally their turn!

Farmer Birthday adds a complete birthday system for the player character, allowing NPCs to acknowledge your special day through personalized greetings, friendship-based gifts, and birthday letters.

The system is designed to feel naturally integrated into Stardew Valley without replacing the normal flow of the game.


━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🎉 MAIN FEATURES
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🎂 YOUR FARMER HAS A BIRTHDAY

Choose your farmer's birthday and let the residents of Stardew Valley celebrate the day with you.

The birthday system integrates directly into normal gameplay.


💬 BIRTHDAY GREETINGS

NPCs can personally wish you a happy birthday when you talk to them.

NPCs with at least 2 hearts of friendship can give you a birthday greeting.

Each supported NPC has multiple birthday dialogue variations so conversations don't always feel identical.

🎁 FRIENDSHIP-BASED BIRTHDAY GIFTS

NPCs with at least 7 hearts of friendship can give you a birthday present when you meet them on your birthday.

The gift system uses the NPC's own gift preferences to choose more interesting and appropriate presents.

Farmer Birthday also validates gifts before giving them to the player, helping prevent invalid items, error items, category tokens, or other unusable objects from being selected.


💌 BIRTHDAY LETTERS

Didn't meet one of your close friends during your birthday?

They haven't forgotten you!

Eligible NPCs you didn't meet can send you a belated birthday letter through Stardew Valley's normal mailbox system.

Birthday letters can also contain gifts.

The mail system uses Stardew Valley's native mail mechanics so the feature feels naturally integrated into the game.


❤️ FRIENDSHIP MATTERS

Your relationship with each NPC determines how they celebrate your birthday.

2+ Hearts:
The NPC can personally wish you a happy birthday.

7+ Hearts:
The NPC becomes eligible to give you a birthday gift and, when applicable, send a birthday letter if you don't meet during your birthday.

This makes building friendships more meaningful while keeping the birthday system connected to normal Stardew Valley progression.


━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🎈 ABOUT BIRTHDAY EVENTS
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Farmer Birthday is NOT focused on large birthday parties, custom birthday festivals, large scripted events, or special birthday cutscenes.

This is intentional.

The mod was designed around natural interactions during your normal Stardew Valley day: NPCs recognizing your birthday, talking to you, giving you gifts, and sending letters when you don't meet them.

This approach keeps Farmer Birthday lightweight and independent.

The core mod requires ONLY SMAPI.

It does not require additional event frameworks, custom festival frameworks, or other mods to make the birthday system work.

The goal is not to turn your birthday into a large scripted event.

Instead, Farmer Birthday makes your birthday feel acknowledged throughout an otherwise normal day in Stardew Valley.


━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🎬 SAFE AROUND EVENTS AND CUTSCENES
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Normal Stardew Valley events always take priority.

Farmer Birthday is designed not to replace important dialogue during events, cutscenes, quests, special interactions, or other scripted sequences.

Birthday interactions are handled during safe, normal conversations with NPCs.

This also helps maintain compatibility with events added by supported expansions.


━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🗺️ EXPANSION SUPPORT
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Farmer Birthday includes optional compatibility for major Stardew Valley expansions.

Supported integrations include:

• Stardew Valley Expanded
• Ridgeside Village
• East Scarp
• Sunberry Village

These expansions are completely optional.

You DO NOT need to install any of them to use Farmer Birthday.

If a supported expansion is installed, Farmer Birthday can load its corresponding NPC birthday dialogues and mail integration.

If the expansion isn't installed, Farmer Birthday simply ignores that integration.

The base mod works perfectly with Vanilla Stardew Valley.


━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🌎 MULTILINGUAL SUPPORT
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Farmer Birthday includes localized birthday dialogue and mail support for:

• English
• Brazilian Portuguese
• German
• Spanish
• French
• Italian

The appropriate supported language is loaded automatically according to your game language.


━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⚙️ REQUIREMENTS
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Required:

• Stardew Valley 1.6+
• SMAPI

That's it.

Farmer Birthday does NOT require Stardew Valley Expanded, Ridgeside Village, East Scarp, Sunberry Village, Content Patcher, SpaceCore, or other expansion frameworks for its core functionality.

Expansion-related dependencies are only necessary if you choose to install those expansions themselves.


━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🎂 HOW IT WORKS
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

After installing Farmer Birthday, the mod allows you to configure your farmer's birthday.

On your birthday:

• NPCs with sufficient friendship can recognize your birthday.
• NPCs with 2+ hearts can give birthday greetings.
• NPCs with 7+ hearts can become eligible to give birthday presents.
• Close friends you don't meet can send birthday letters afterward.
• Letters may contain birthday gifts.
• Supported expansion NPCs participate when their expansion is installed.
• Normal events and cutscenes retain priority over birthday interactions.


━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🎁 THE IDEA BEHIND FARMER BIRTHDAY
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

In Stardew Valley, the farmer spends years remembering everyone else's birthdays.

You learn what they love.
You find their favorite gifts.
You visit them on their special day.

Farmer Birthday gives the residents of the valley a chance to return the favor.

No enormous festival is necessary.

Sometimes a birthday greeting from a friend, an unexpected present, or a letter waiting in the mailbox the next morning is enough to make the farmer's birthday feel special.


━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
📦 INSTALLATION
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

1. Install SMAPI.
2. Download Farmer Birthday.
3. Extract the Farmer Birthday folder into your Stardew Valley Mods folder.
4. Launch the game through SMAPI.
5. Configure your farmer's birthday.
6. Enjoy finally having your own birthday in Stardew Valley!


━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🧩 COMPATIBILITY PHILOSOPHY
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Farmer Birthday was designed with modular compatibility in mind.

Vanilla Stardew Valley is the foundation.

Expansion integrations are optional additions.

The mod does not force players to install expansions or large dependency chains just to give their farmer a birthday.

Install only the expansions you actually want to play.

Farmer Birthday will handle the supported integrations that are available.


━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🎂 FARMER BIRTHDAY
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Because after remembering everyone else's birthday...

the farmer deserves one too.
